ev.q: Persons aged ≥75 years were approximately three times more likely than persons aged 65--74 years to report ADLs
Summary health statistics for the U.S. population: National Health Interview Survey, 2008.

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population.
Persons with unknown limitation status were excluded from the denominators.
